tests.name: example1
tests.description: s=aaaa queries=[0,1,2,3]: multi-gap trace. g=0->2 (a,aa), g=1->1 (a), g=2->1 (a), g=3->0. Verified by algorithm trace in problem.md.

tests.name: example2
tests.description: s=abcabc queries=[0,1,2,3]: six substrings non-overlapping, five gap-1, three gap-2, zero gap-3. Verified by brute force.

tests.name: example3
tests.description: s=abab queries=[0,1,2]: g=0->3 (a,b,ab), g=1->2 (a,b; ab has gap=0<1), g=2->0. Verified by brute force. Mapping: Edge case #1 (g=0).

tests.name: single_char
tests.description: s=z queries=[0]: single character, never repeated. Output [0]. Mapping: Edge case #3 (single-character string).

tests.name: length2_boundary
tests.description: s=aa queries=[0,1]: g=0->1 (a is non-overlapping), g=1=|s|-1->0 (gap=0<1). Covers boundary g=|s|-1 for n=2. Mapping: Pitfall #4 (off-by-one in length-range boundary).

tests.name: no_repeats_g0
tests.description: s=abc queries=[0]: all distinct characters, no repeated substrings. Output [0]. Mapping: Edge case #5 (all distinct characters).

tests.name: no_repeats_g_positive
tests.description: s=abcde queries=[1,4]: no substring repeats at all, so g>0 cannot help. Output [0,0]. Tests that an all-distinct string with g>0 correctly returns zero.

tests.name: all_same_n6_multi
tests.description: s=aaaaaa (n=6) queries=[0,2,4]: good lengths are L<=floor((n-g)/2). g=0->3, g=2->2, g=4->1. Verified by SAM analysis. Mapping: Edge case #4 (all-same characters).

tests.name: gap_tiebreaker_abab
tests.description: s=abab queries=[1]: isolated test where g=1 eliminates 'ab' (gap=0 between [1,2] and [3,4]) but keeps 'a' and 'b' (both have gap=1). Output [2]. This is the tiebreaker test for g=1. Mapping: Pitfall #1 (missing +g offset).

tests.name: periodic_ababab_multi
tests.description: s=ababab (n=6) queries=[0,1,3,4]: g=0->4, g=1->3, g=3->2, g=4->0. Verified by brute force. Mapping: Pitfall #3 (wrong propagation order / ascending sort bug).

tests.name: clone_abacaba_multi
tests.description: s=abacaba (n=7) queries=[0,2,3,6]: exercises clone state creation in SAM. g=6=|s|-1->0 (boundary). Verified by brute force and SAM clone analysis. Mapping: Edge case #7 (cloned SAM states), Pitfall #2 (clone min/max initialization).

tests.name: palindrome_abcba
tests.description: s=abcba (n=5) queries=[0,2]: 'a' (d=4>=1) and 'b' (d=2>=1) are good at g=0; only 'a' (d=4>=3) at g=2. Output [2,1].

tests.name: overlap_only_aaa_multi
tests.description: s=aaa (n=3) queries=[0,1,2]: 'aa' overlaps (gap=-1 for all pairs). Only 'a' passes g=0 and g=1 (max gap=1). g=2->0. Output [1,1,0].

tests.name: long_all_same_n10
tests.description: s='a'*10 (n=10) queries=[0,4]: good lengths L<=floor((10-g)/2). g=0->5, g=4->3. Output [5,3].

tests.name: aabaa_multi
tests.description: s=aabaa (n=5) queries=[0,2,4]: g=0->2 (a,aa), g=2->1 (a only, d=4>=3), g=4=|s|-1->0. Covers max boundary g=|s|-1=4 inline. Output [2,1,0].

tests.name: max_g_boundary_dedicated
tests.description: s=abba (n=4) queries=[3]: dedicated test for g=|s|-1=3. 'a' at ends 1,4 has d=3>=1+3=4? No. 'b' at ends 2,3 has d=1. No substring qualifies. Output [0]. Mapping: Edge case #2 (g=|s|-1 maximum valid query).

tests.name: identical_values
tests.description: s=aaaa queries=[0]: all elements identical. Tests tie-breaking neutrality (any pair of end positions). Output [2].

tests.name: multi_query_single_s
tests.description: s=abcabc queries=[0,3]: multi-query that hits non-trivial and zero-result in one call. Confirms output is a list. Output [6,0].

tests.name: stress_n200000_g0_seed42
tests.description: Performance test: s=200000 random lowercase chars (seed=42), queries=[0,100,1000]. Tests O(n log n + Q*n) at max constraint. Expected outputs computed by reference solution.

tests.name: stress_n200000_binary_seed7
tests.description: Worst-case: s=200000 binary (ab) chars (seed=7), queries=[0,1000]. Binary alphabet maximizes SAM states. Expected outputs computed by reference solution.

tests.name: stress_n200000_multi_seed13
tests.description: Performance test with multiple queries: s=200000 random lowercase chars (seed=13), queries=[0,100]. Tests multi-query efficiency. Expected outputs computed by reference solution.

tests.name: unordered_queries
tests.description: queries=[2,0,1] on s=abcabc: output must follow INPUT order [3,6,5], not sorted order [6,5,3]. Catches bugs that sort queries before processing.

tests.name: duplicate_queries_preserve_order
tests.description: Duplicate queries must be answered independently and preserved in output order. s=abcabc gives g=0->6 and g=2->3, so [0,0,2] maps to [6,6,3]. Mapping: Edge case #6 (multiple identical queries).

tests.name: max_queries_len10_mixed_order
tests.description: Constraint-bound test with |queries|=10 (maximum). s=abcabc with mixed and repeated gaps verifies full-length query handling and output order preservation.

tests.name: max_queries_len10_no_repeats
tests.description: Constraint-bound test with |queries|=10 on an all-distinct string. Ensures every query returns 0 while respecting full query-list length.

tests.name: stress_n200000_max_queries_len10_seed99
tests.description: Performance and boundary test: n=200000 random lowercase (seed=99) with |queries|=10 (maximum). Expected outputs computed by reference solution.

tests.name: complex_clone_aababcabcd
tests.description: String with multiple SAM clone events to stress-test clone min/max initialization and propagation. Verified by brute force.

tests.name: two_char_alternating_n8
tests.description: Alternating binary string of length 8 to test longer periodic patterns with multiple gap values. Verified by brute force.

tests.name: repeated_block_xyzxyz
tests.description: Two copies of a 3-char block, testing that all sub-block substrings are found g-good at appropriate gap values.

tests.name: near_overlap_aabaa_g1
tests.description: Isolated g=1 test on aabaa where 'aa' has occurrences [1,2] and [4,5] with gap=1, just barely qualifying.

tests.name: single_repeat_at_ends
tests.description: Only first and last characters match, testing spread equals n-1 for single char but no other repeats.

tests.name: three_blocks_abcabcabc
tests.description: Three repetitions of a 3-char block, testing that longer repeated substrings like 'abcabc' are detected and gap conditions are checked correctly across multiple overlapping periods.

tests.name: aab_repeated_aabaabaab
tests.description: String with period 3 (aab) repeated 3 times, testing SAM clone behavior with non-uniform character distribution and multiple gap thresholds.

tests.name: single_char_pair_aa
tests.description: Minimal string with exactly one repeated substring. Only 'a' is g-good for g=0, nothing for g=1.

tests.name: long_period_abcdabcd
tests.description: Two copies of a 4-char block, testing period-4 pattern with various gap values. All 10 repeated substrings have spread exactly 4.

tests.name: mixed_structure_aabcaabc
tests.description: Non-trivially structured string with overlapping repeat patterns, testing that SAM correctly groups endpos sets and clone states propagate min/max.

tests.name: all_same_n5_all_gaps
tests.description: All-same string of length 5 with every valid gap value. Tests the formula L <= floor((n-g)/2) systematically.

tests.name: query_g_zero_only_abcabc
tests.description: Single query g=0, isolating the basic non-overlapping pair count without gap complications.

tests.name: two_char_string_ab
tests.description: Minimal two-character string with no repeats. Tests that n=2 with all-distinct chars returns 0.

tests.name: aba_gap_test
tests.description: String 'aba' where only 'a' repeats (ends at 1,3, spread=2). g=0: 2>=1 yes (count 1). g=1: 2>=2 yes (count 1). g=2: 2>=3 no (count 0).

tests.name: abcabc_g0_only
tests.description: Isolated g=0 query on abcabc to verify basic non-overlapping count matches example 2.

tests.name: aaaaaa_all_gaps
tests.description: All-same string n=6 with all valid gap values. Tests formula L <= floor((n-g)/2). g=0->3, g=1->2, g=2->2, g=3->1, g=4->1, g=5->0.

tests.name: abcabcabc_g4
tests.description: Three repetitions of abc, isolated g=4 query. Verified by brute force: a(d=6>=5 yes), b(d=6>=5 yes), c(d=6>=5 yes), ab(d=6>=6 yes), bc(d=6>=6 yes), abc(d=6>=7 no). Count=5.

tests.name: offbyone_lo_regression_aaaa
tests.description: Dedicated regression test for off-by-one in length-range lower bound. If lo is incorrectly set to len[link[v]] instead of len[link[v]]+1, substring 'a' gets double-counted, producing [3] instead of [2].

tests.name: exact_gap_boundary_qualification
tests.description: Tests exact boundary where gap equals minimum qualifying spread. For s=abcabc with g=2, substring 'a' has d=3 and L=1, so d >= L+g becomes 3 >= 3 (exactly qualifying). Validates >= not > comparison.

tests.name: long_period_abcabcabc_g4
tests.description: Tests gap value larger than the period. s=abcabcabc (period 3, length 9). With g=4, only short substrings with wide spread qualify. Verified by brute force.

tests.name: clone_stress_aabaab
tests.description: String aabaab triggers multiple clone events in SAM construction. Tests that cloned states receive correct min/max only through propagation, not from copying the original state.

tests.name: all_same_n200000_g0
tests.description: Stress test with all-same characters at maximum length. s='a'*200000, queries=[0]. Answer = floor(200000/2) = 100000. Tests SAM behavior on minimal-state-count input.

tests.name: all_same_n200000_multi_gaps
tests.description: Stress test with all-same chars at max length, multiple gap values. s='a'*200000, queries=[0,99999,199999]. g=0->100000, g=99999->floor((200000-99999)/2)=50000, g=199999->0.

tests.name: abcde_single_repeat_far
tests.description: Only character 'a' repeats at positions 1 and 10. Tests that large spread (d=9) allows high gap values for single-char substring.

tests.name: banana_classic
tests.description: Classic string 'banana' with multiple clone events and varied repeat patterns. Verified by brute force enumeration.

tests.name: mississippi
tests.description: Classic string 'mississippi' with complex SAM structure. Verified by brute force enumeration of all distinct substrings.

tests.name: aba_palindrome
tests.description: Three-character palindrome. Only 'a' repeats with end positions {1,3}, spread=2. g=0: d=2>=1 yes (count 1). g=1: d=2>=2 yes (count 1). g=2: d=2>=3 no (count 0).

tests.name: long_period_abcabc_extended
tests.description: Four repetitions of 'abc' giving rich overlap structure. Tests SAM with period-3 pattern and multiple gap thresholds.

tests.name: alternating_ab_n10
tests.description: Alternating ab pattern of length 10 with comprehensive gap range. Tests periodic binary string behavior.
